p.em: Who uses the system and what external systems does it talk to?

g.title: Traveller searching for flights, creating bookings, and making payments through the web app
Airline staff who can create and manage bookings on behalf of passengers
Airline booking platform — search flights, book seats, process payments, confirm bookings
Thai payment gateway — credit/debit card processing
